A1.name: Golden Gate Unlocked
A1.title: Golden Gate Unlocked · Towers Down in Turn
A1.briefing: Soviet resistance fighters hijacked the convoy onto the Golden Gate Bridge. The demolition men atop the north and south towers set off their charges the moment they see their own side fall. Retake the convoy without being seen from the towers.

A2.name: Storm over the Dam
A2.title: Storm over the Dam · Counter Each Wave
A2.briefing: Soviet agents plan to blow up the Hoover Dam tonight. They hug the dam wall, so any shell fired at them hits the dam too. Every wave brings different troops by a different route: read it, then switch your units to hold the line.
objectives: Beat back the first wave of agents on the dam crest
Hold the dam through the final wave

A3.name: Greenwich Time Lag
A3.title: Greenwich Time Lag · Dodge the Stasis Ring
A3.briefing: An accident at Greenwich froze everyone east of the meridian, and the stasis field keeps spreading west while Soviet troops hunt the civilians. Get the living out to the docks.
objectives: Escort the civilians to the Greenwich docks
Pull out the troops trapped in the riverside district

A4.name: The Soldiers in the Ice
A4.title: Sapporo Snow Festival · Horns and Ice Walls
A4.briefing: Hokkaido has impounded a batch of clones Shimada left behind, to hand them over to a containment agency. Imperial remnants have dug tunnels under the snow festival's ice sculptures. Take the convoy through the festival grounds to the harbor.
objectives: Escort the convoy to the gate of Plaza Two
Deliver the convoy to the harbor

A5.name: Locks of Panama
A5.title: Locks of Panama · Seize the Control Room, Free the Fleet
A5.briefing: The Allied fleet is pinned in the Panama locks by a Soviet Terror Drill, and the water rises and falls with no way out. The control room sits on a plateau on the east bank, reachable by a single ramp. Take it and let the fleet out to sea.
objectives: Release the fleet to the sea

A6.name: The Ancient Server
A6.title: The Ancient Server · Prism Light Through the Stones
A6.briefing: Selinsky has been missing for three weeks; his last signal came from under Stonehenge. Sentry towers hide behind the standing stones, invisible from outside. Tanya goes in as the eyes, the Prism Tanks stay outside as the guns.
objectives: Take down the outer ring's sentry towers
Take down the three towers of the inner ring

A7.name: Hawk
A7.title: Hawk · Hold the Line, Force It Down
A7.briefing: The Liberty flies to the Niagara power station and always jumps to the emptiest stretch of your defenses. Hold your base, open the road to the station, and pin it under your guns without shooting it down.
objectives: Open the road to the power station
Bring the Liberty down to ten percent health

A8.name: Press Conference at Sea
A8.title: Press Conference at Sea · Jump In, Tear Down Platforms
A8.briefing: Hale is holding a press conference on the open sea; his machine warms up on three power platforms and will be fully charged tonight. In the Liberty he gave you, jump from platform to platform and tear them down to wreck the show.
objectives: Tear down the first power platform
Tear down the last power platform

A9.name: Brussels, 1927
A9.title: Brussels, 1927 · Take Down the Nine Spheres in Turn
A9.briefing: Hale has shipped the machine to Brussels. The Atomium is its antenna, its nine spheres charge in turn, and when the countdown ends he goes back to 1927. Destroy every sphere before then.
